verdict.rationale: A payments platform with a Customer Area could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The MCP server only lets developers use natural language through their own external LLM client, which is an adjacent building block rather than in-product insights. The tipping 'suggested tip amount' is a merchant-set value, not AI-generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
